Tab

Tab component for switching between different content areas.(Minimum version: 24.9.0)

Import

Import components in app.json or index.json.

"usingComponents": {
  "maui-tab": "@macle/maui/tab/index",
  "maui-tabs": "@macle/maui/tabs/index"
}

Sample Code

Basic Usage

Use active to set the index value corresponding to the currently active tag. The first tag is enabled by default.

<maui-tabs active="{{ active }}" bind:change="onChange">
  <maui-tab title="Label 1">content 1</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 2">content 2</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 3">content 3</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 4">content 4</maui-tab>
</maui-tabs>

Page({
  data: {
    active: 1,
  },

  onChange(event) {
    ma.showToast({
      title: `switch to ${event.detail.name}`,
      icon: 'none',
    });
  },
});

Match by Name

When the tag specifies the name attribute, the value of active is the name of the current tag (the tag cannot be matched by the index value at this time).

<maui-tabs active="a">
  <maui-tab title="Label 1" name="a">content 1</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 2" name="b">content 2</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 3" name="c">content 3</maui-tab>
</maui-tabs>

Horizontal Scrolling

Tabs can scroll horizontally when there are more than 5 tabs.

<maui-tabs active="{{ active }}">
  <maui-tab title="Label 1">content 1</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 2">content 2</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 3">content 3</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 4">content 4</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 5">content 5</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 6">content 6</maui-tab>
</maui-tabs>

Disable Tag

The label can be disabled by setting the disabled attribute. If you need to listen to the click event of a disabled tab, you can listen to the disabled event on maui-tabs.

<maui-tabs bind:disabled="onClickDisabled">
  <maui-tab title="Label 1">content 1</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 2" disabled>content 2</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 3">content 3</maui-tab>
</maui-tabs>

Page({
  onClickDisabled(event) {
    ma.showToast({
      title: `Label ${event.detail.name} has been disabled`,
      icon: 'none',
    });
  },
});

Style

Tab supports two styles: line and card. The default is line style, which can be modified through the type attribute.

<maui-tabs type="card">
  <maui-tab title="Label 1">content 1</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 2">content 2</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 3">content 3</maui-tab>
</maui-tabs>

Click Event

The click event can be bound to maui-tabs, and the title and identifier of the clicked tab can be obtained in the event.detail of the callback parameter.

<maui-tabs bind:click="onClick">
  <maui-tab title="Label 1">content 1</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 2">content 2</maui-tab>
</maui-tabs>

Page({
  onClick(event) {
    ma.showToast({
      title: `${event.detail.name} clicked`,
      icon: 'none',
    });
  },
});

Sticky Layout

Sticky layout can be enabled through the sticky attribute. Under sticky layout, when the Tab scrolls to the top, it will automatically stick to the top.

<maui-tabs sticky>
  <maui-tab title="Label 1">content 1</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 2">content 2</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 3">content 3</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 4">content 4</maui-tab>
</maui-tabs>

Switch Animation

You can use animated to set whether to enable animation when switching tabs.

<maui-tabs animated>
  <maui-tab title="Label 1">content 1</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 2">content 2</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 3">content 3</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 4">content 4</maui-tab>
</maui-tabs>

Slide to Switch

Swipe switching tabs can be enabled through the swipeable attribute.

<maui-tabs swipeable>
  <maui-tab title="Label 1">content 1</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 2">content 2</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 3">content 3</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 4">content 4</maui-tab>
</maui-tabs>

Asynchronous Switching

Through the before-change event, specific logic can be executed before switching tags to achieve the purpose of verification before switching and asynchronous switching.

<maui-tabs active="{{ active }}" use-before-change="{{ true }}" bind:change="onChange" bind:before-change="onBeforeChange" >
  <maui-tab title="Label 1">content 1</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 2">content 2</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 3">content 3</maui-tab>
  <maui-tab title="Label 4">content 4</maui-tab>
</maui-tabs>

Page({
  data: {
    active: 1,
  },

  onChange(event) {
    ma.showToast({
      title: `Switch to ${event.detail.name}`,
      icon: 'none',
    });
  },
  onBeforeChange(event) {
    const { callback, title } = event.detail;

    ma.showModal({
      title: 'Asynchronous switching',
      content: `Are you sure you want to switch to the ${title} tab?`,
      success: (res) => {
        if (res.confirm) {
          callback(true)
        } else if (res.cancel) {
          callback(false)
        }
      },
    })
  }
});

API

Tabs Props

Parameter Description Type Default Value
type Style, optional value is card String line
color Label theme color String #ee0a24
active The identifier of the currently selected tag String |Number 0
duration Animation time in seconds Number 0.3
line-width Bottom bar width, default unit px String |Number 40px
line-height Bottom bar height, default unit px String |Number 3px
animated Whether to enable transition animation when switching tab content Boolean false
border Whether to display the outer border, only effective in line style Boolean false
ellipsis Whether to omit excessively long title text Boolean true
sticky Whether to use sticky positioning layout Boolean false
swipeable Whether to enable gesture sliding switching Boolean false
lazy-render Whether to enable delayed rendering of tab content Boolean true
offset-top The minimum distance from the top under sticky positioning layout, unit px Number -
swipe-threshold Scroll threshold. Horizontal scrolling starts when the number of tabs exceeds the threshold and the total width exceeds the tab bar width. Number 5
title-active-color Title selected state color String -
title-inactive-color Title default color String -
z-index z-index level Number 1
use-before-change Whether to enable verification before switching Boolean false

Tab Props

Parameter Description Type Default Value
name tag name as matching identifier String |Number The index value of the label
title title String -
disabled Whether to disable tags Boolean false
dot Whether to display the little red dot Boolean -
info Prompt information in the upper right corner of the icon String |Number -
title-style Custom title style String -

Tab Slot

Name Description
- Tab content

Tabs Event

Event Name Description Parameter
bind:click Fires when a label is clicked name: tag identifier, title: title
bind:beforechange It will be triggered before tab switching. Return false in the callback function to terminate the tab switching. When binding the event, you need to set the use-before-change attribute to true event.detail.name: the currently switched tab identifier, event.detail.title: the currently switched tab title, event.detail.index: the currently switched tab index, event.detail.callback : Callback function, call callback(false) to terminate tab switching
bind:change Fires when the currently active tag changes name: tag identifier, title: title
bind:disabled Fires when a disabled tab is clicked name: tag identifier, title: title
bind:scroll Fires when scrolling, the specific value can be obtained only after the sticky layout is enabled. { scrollTop: distance from the top, isFixed: whether to ceiling }
